title: Primitive-root sheaf square under field extension
statement: Let k contained in K be a field extension [def-sc-field-extension], C a scheme over k [def-weil-scheme-over-base], n a positive integer, and zeta a primitive nth root in k whose image in K is primitive. Set P=C_K and pi:P to C. Let phi be a morphism from the pi-inverse image of C's Kummer complex [def-sc-kummer-sequence] to P's Kummer complex whose middle component is the canonical comparison of units [lem-sc-kummer-base-change-compatibility]. Write theta and thetaK for the sheaf trivializations associated to the two primitive roots [def-sc-mu-trivialization], and alpha for the canonical inverse-image comparison of constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then pi^*(theta) followed by phi's first component equals alpha followed by thetaK.

proof.text: Let uC and uP be the global units used by the two primitive-root trivializations. Units.ext, the pullback square pi followed by f equals g followed by Spec(algebraMap), Hom.comp_appTop, and naturality of the inverse of GammaSpecIso prove that pullback of uC equals uP. Their nth powers are one by the supplied primitive-root hypotheses.

Postcompose the desired equality by the kernel inclusion of mu_n into Gm. The first commutative square of the supplied short-complex morphism and its supplied middle-component equality turn the left composite into inverse image of theta followed by inverse image of the kernel inclusion, then the units comparison. Functoriality and kernel.lift_ι identify the composite theta followed by inclusion with the constant-sheaf power map on each scheme.

Apply [lem-sc-power-map-pullback] to pi and the global units uC and uP from the first step. This proves the equality after the two kernel inclusions. Cancel the monomorphism kernel.ι to conclude the original equality.

theorem constant_root_trivialization_baseChange
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (n : ℕ) [NeZero n]
    (ζ : k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n)
    (hζK : IsPrimitiveRoot (algebraMap k K ζ) n)
    (φ : ((Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).mapShortComplex.obj
        (C.kummerSequence n)) ⟶
      (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).kummerSequence n)
    (hφ : φ.τ₂ = upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))) :
    (Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).map
        (C.constantZModIsoRootsOfUnitySheaf n f hζ).hom ≫ φ.τ₁ =
      (((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).app
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))).hom) ≫
      ((pullback f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).constantZModIsoRootsOfUnitySheaf n
          (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) hζK).hom
